articles.title: Polymarket traders cut Clarity Act passage odds to record low as Senate delay drags on
articles.snippet: Polymarket bettors have cut the odds of the CLARITY Act passing this year to a record low as Senate negotiations over ethics provisions remain unresolved.

articles.title: This $28 million ether market bet aims to profit from pure market chaos
articles.snippet: The mega trade aims to profit from a potential surge in ether price turbulence.

articles.title: MacOS malware hijacks Telegram sessions, targets crypto wallets: SlowMist
articles.snippet: A macOS malware steals credentials to hijack Telegram sessions, decrypt cryptocurrency wallets or trick users into entering their wallet recovery phrases through fake applications.
